problemStatements.title: AI-Based Video Analytics for Perimeter Security
problemStatements.shortDescription: Advanced AI video analytics for enhanced perimeter security.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Develop an AI-driven system for video analytics to enhance perimeter security. The system should use computer vision to detect and alert on unauthorized intrusions or suspicious activities around sensitive defense boundaries.

problemStatements.title: Secure Battlefield Communication Simulator (Non-Operational)
problemStatements.shortDescription: Simulator for secure communication in battlefield environments.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Create a non-operational simulation platform focused on secure communication within battlefield environments. The goal is to model and test encrypted data exchange and resilient network topologies for defense.

problemStatements.title: Cyber Threat Detection System for Defense Networks
problemStatements.shortDescription: Dedicated cyber threat detection for defense networks.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Build a cyber threat detection system tailored for defense networks. The system should employ advanced monitoring and analysis techniques to identify and mitigate potential security breaches and malicious activities.

problemStatements.title: Smart Garments Engine
problemStatements.shortDescription: Intelligent recommendation engine for smart garments.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Develop a smart garments engine integrated with a knowledge base for intelligent recommendations. The focus should be on performance, health monitoring, or tactical assistance for personnel.

problemStatements.title: AI-Powered Knowledge Base
problemStatements.shortDescription: AI-powered system for intelligent info storage and retrieval.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Build an AI-powered knowledge base designed for intelligent information storage and retrieval, streamlining the management of complex data and facilitating efficient access to critical information.

problemStatements.title: AI-Based Early Warning System for Landslides
problemStatements.shortDescription: Early warning system for landslides affecting defense infra.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Develop an AI-based early warning system for monitoring and predicting landslides that could impact strategic defense infrastructure, providing timely alerts to prevent damage.

problemStatements.title: AI-Based CAR Monitoring System
problemStatements.shortDescription: AI monitoring for mine-induced instability near defense zones.
problemStatements.fullDescription: Create a monitoring system using AI to track Carbon Absorption Rates (CAR) to identify terrain instability caused by mining near defense zones, ensuring environmental and structural safety.

items.name: KEC
items.paragraph: Kongu Engineering College, affiliated to Anna University, is located in Perundurai, Erode. It is accredited with an 'A' grade by National Assessment Accreditation Council. Over the past 40 years, the instituton with its good infrastructure facility and excellent academic records has emerged as a center of excellence.The college with its quality education and peaceful environment provides continuous improvement and confidence for the students to face the real world challenges and mould their future.

items.name: CSEA
items.paragraph: The Computer Science and Engineering Association (CSEA) is a vibrant student-driven body that forms the backbone of academic, technical, and cultural activities in the CSE department. It serves as a dynamic forum where students come together to explore, learn, and innovate beyond the classroom. By organizing guest lectures, technical talks, workshops, Crescitons, symposium, and cultural events, CSEA provides ample opportunities to sharpen technical knowledge, foster leadership, and nurture creativity. Acting as a bridge between industry, and students, the association keeps members connected with emerging technologies while encouraging collaboration, problem-solving, and holistic growth. With its diverse initiatives, CSEA not only cultivates professional excellence but also builds a strong sense of community, preparing students to meet industry expectations and contribute meaningfully to society.

items.name: CCC
items.paragraph: The CSE Coding Club is a vibrant community of coding enthusiasts in the Computer Science and Engineering department. By organizing coding events, Crescitons, workshops, and mock drives, the club empowers students to sharpen their coding skills, think creatively, and tackle real-world problems. These activities foster a spirit of innovation, teamwork, and healthy competition among members. The CSE Coding Club is an ideal platform for students to learn from peers, get hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, and build a strong portfolio of coding projects.
